verified.entry_point: HTTP attachment download handlers (global, repository and repository-release addresses), driven in-process against the project's integration test server (SQLite)
sites: routers/web/repo/attachment.go:131-173 (draft gate on the shared download handler)
routes: anonymous and reader UUID download through the global attachment address
anonymous and reader UUID download through a repository-scoped address
anonymous and reader UUID download through a repository-release-scoped address
published release asset download through the three UUID addresses and the tag/latest download aliases
writer access to a draft release asset
uploader access to an unlinked attachment
linked attachment recorded without an owning repository id, served in its owning repository

patch_checks.why: blind fix produced by run_blindfix after the first gate

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the control ships the minimum checks that isolate the advisory route; the crash variant is proven on the stacked task
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the control covers only the draft download gate, not the owning-repository decision
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the control ships the minimum checks that isolate the advisory route; the anonymous-only variant is proven on the stacked task
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected route is a read; there is no write-side variant to guard instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the control ships the minimum checks that isolate the advisory route; the ordering variant is proven on the stacked task
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control's suite already drives every address that reaches the handler
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the lookup key is a server-generated random identifier; no caller-supplied parsing form decides the result
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the control ships the minimum checks that isolate the advisory route; the read-instead-of-write variant is proven on the stacked task
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the control's security suite covers only the web download handler

traps.shape: The shared download handler checks only read permission on the linked unit and never consults the draft state of the release the file belongs to.
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the handler's only permission test is a read check on the linked unit
